summary: TORM plc filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated September 11, 2026, disclosing a capital increase of 31,483 Class A common shares, par value $0.01, issued on exercise of an equal number of Restricted Stock Units under its incentive program. New shares were subscribed in cash at DKK 179.80 each, raising nominal capital by USD 314.83, with no pre-emption rights. Post-issuance capital totals USD 1,024,212.67 across 102,421,267 A-shares, each carrying one vote, expected to list on Nasdaq Copenhagen. This is a routine equity incentive settlement, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendation apply.
